top_signals.headline: Kalshi closes $1B Series F at $22B valuation
top_signals.summary: Luana Lopes Lara, co-founder. Coatue-led. The largest female-co-founded round of the week and a milestone for both prediction markets and Latina founders.

top_signals.headline: Aurora Tech Award: all-women teams deliver 2x revenue per VC dollar - and get 1.4%
top_signals.summary: InDrive-backed Aurora Ventures launched with $180-250K checks for women in MENA, Africa and LatAm, alongside a 900-founder, 127-country study showing all-women teams generate $0.78 in revenue per VC dollar vs $0.31 for all-male teams.

top_signals.headline: Switzerland female-led funding jumped 6.9% to 12.2% in two years
top_signals.summary: Swiss GP Arijana Walcott's data shows female-CEO companies almost doubled their VC share between 2023 and 2025. But all-female teams are still at 1.7% in Switzerland and 1.2% across Europe - a decade low.

top_signals.headline: Ex-PayPal exec launches AeQuitas Invest, a Reg CF platform for women founders
top_signals.summary: Molly Huyck's new platform routes Regulation Crowdfunding capital to women-led startups. Underlying data: women-led startups got under 2% of US VC in 2025 while delivering 2.5x better returns per dollar invested.

top_signals.headline: UK female founders: 2% equity for a decade, GBP 310B opportunity
top_signals.summary: 150Sec deep-dive synthesizing Barclays, UK Treasury and Beauhurst data. Female founders received 2% of UK equity for ten years running; closing the gap is a GBP 310B economic opportunity per Barclays.
